comment: Design 129 S1's shared contract (s7.1), with design 129b's enrolment rows (s10.2). The crypto rows are scripts/device-key-vectors.py's (a throwaway key from a fake phrase - public data only); the route rows are produced by the server's tests::device_key through the real routes. Byte-identical in the launcher's test resources (L1): its DeviceKeyContractTest builds the canonical and proof rows, computes the clock, maps the answers and runs the phone rows (the registration flow's decision).

encodings.signature: DER ECDSA P-256 SHA-256, Base64url without padding
encodings.proof: DER ECDSA P-256 SHA-256, Base64url without padding

signed.name: the body hash header names another body

proof.name: a register proof is no enrol proof

sig_now.name: the wall clock behind the floor: the floor, at nine tenths of real time
the wall clock past the floor: the wall clock
a quick restart: still ahead of the wall clock, catching up
a quick restart: back on the wall clock once caught up

enroll.repeat_rule: the same code with the same key, in the code's own life, at most twice, each with a proof whose ECDSA r was never seen for it: the phone signs the proof afresh on every attempt
enroll.exempt_repeat_rule: the same attempt after its exempt enrolment, within the code's expiry plus 10 minutes, at most twice, each a fresh bearer

phone.name: a phone on its bearer, no key anywhere
a lost answer committed late: step 1 names the key
a lost answer never committed: another key, this one kept
two keys made, the server names the second
the server names a key the phone doesn't hold
a conflict already reported: keep waiting
adopted and named: nothing to do
an unknown_key wake while a POST is in flight
step 1 had no answer
step 1 answered 5xx
a restore after S2: no bearer, the key unknown - one strike, never lost at once
suspected, then the key is known again
unknown_key while the bearer still goes along
held: adopted, the bearer kept
bound: the bearer goes
bound and the bearer gone already
a rotation asked
a rotation's lost answer: the old key still named
a rotation's commit: the new key named
a refusal still waiting out its time
the server forgot the key (S1, the bearer along)
exempt, tried six days ago: wait
exempt, tried a week ago: register
exempt, no try kept: register
exempt while a refusal waits
the address history is younger than an hour: wait, no key
the list is stale: wait, no key
a challenge: make the key
no challenge: back off, no key

enrol_wait.name: waiting without a key: the next try makes one
a pace under ten seconds is ten
a pace over five minutes is five
a transient answer keeps the schedule
a transient answer without a pace
45 minutes since the first waiting answer: stop
a transient answer at 45 minutes: stop

phone_nudge.name: bound while the bearer is kept

lost_verdict.name: an ask within ten minutes of the last strike: none
ten minutes after the last strike: a strike
three spaced strikes within the hour: not yet
three strikes over an hour: lost
a quick ask at the hour: never lost on it
many strikes, still within the hour
a reboot starts the span again
